# Gauge

Show a numeric sensor as a vertical, horizontal or radial gauge.

## Configure in the editor

1. Open a page in the [web editor](../editor.md#layout-workspace) and add **Gauge**.
2. Use **Search** beside the entity field to choose an entity by name. Configure its options below.
3. Resize the widget for its content, then **Save** the layout. Try its controls on the panel.

Choose a vertical, horizontal or radial presentation and set the sensor's value range.

## Entities and interaction

**Supported primary entities:** `sensor.*`

| Setting / behaviour | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Display | display variant: linear (vertical bar), horizontal (bar filling left to right, title and value in one row above it), radial |
| Options | linear and horizontal: bar presentation (smooth, segmented -- an LED-style column of segment count blocks, 4-30, default 10; fewer on a column too short for them) |
| Range | minimum value, maximum value |
| Extras | radial and horizontal: up to 2 extra readouts (secondary entity, third entity) as small text -- under the value inside the arc, or in one row under the horizontal bar when the tile has room; not separate widgets |
| Interaction | read-only |

## Layout limits

- Minimum: **80 × 160 px** by default; **100 × 70 px** for horizontal.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the selected display device's dashboard area.
- Leave space for the value, title and touch controls; the minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size.

The [display device overview](../choose-display.md) lists usable dashboard geometry. [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains title/content spacing and touch targets.
